name: CSW Summer Day Camp
description_short: A summer day camp on the campus of The Cambridge School of Weston for ages 4-14, run in two-week sessions from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. Activities, led by counselors, include daily swim lessons and free swim in the campus pool, recreational sports, and arts and crafts, both indoors and outdoors. Lunch and snacks are provided.
refund_policy_summary: A $250 non-refundable deposit per session is due at registration. Deposits are not refunded after March 1, 2027. Other payments (less deposits) are refundable or transferable until May 1, 2027 with written notice. $100 per session early-bird discount before December 31.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers swim twice a day in CSW's outdoor pool (built 2025, 2.75 to 5 feet deep): lessons in the morning and free swim in the afternoon. Certified lifeguards are led by an Aquatics Director. A swim test (two widths and 60 seconds treading water) is needed for the deep end.
